title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Going to Sleep 😂 #adhd #shorts
desc:
Lights off → brain turns ON → octopus facts at 3 AM. 😂 What does YOUR brain do at bedtime? 👇

Tip: keep a notepad by the bed. Dump every thought on paper so your brain can stop holding it.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #adhdsleep #shorts #relatable

beats.say: Here's how a normal person goes to sleep. Lights off. Eyes closed. Asleep.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. Big day tomorrow. Early night. I got this.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Lights off. And my brain says, perfect, now we can think.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Remember that thing you said in the seventh grade? Let's replay it. Forty times.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Do octopuses sleep? I need to know. Right now.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: They do. They change colors when they dream. That's incredible. Now I'm watching a video about deep sea fish.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay. Phone down. For real. Eyes closed.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Did I pay the light bill? Did I answer that email? What if I just started a podcast?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Now I'm planning the podcast. I've got a name. I've got a logo. I've got episode twelve.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Alarm goes off. I just fell asleep. Twelve minutes ago.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Your brain finally has no other noise, so every open thought gets loud. Keep a notepad by the bed. Write every thought down. Bill, email, podcast, octopus. Once it's on paper, your brain can let go of it.
beats.cap2: Tip: notepad by the bed. Dump every thought on paper.

beats.say: What does your brain do the second the lights go off? Tell me in the comments.
beats.cap: What does YOUR brain do at bedtime?
